evidence.note: RiskSnapshot.is_blocked fires when max_drawdown_limit is breached regardless of notify_drawdown_alerts. RiskAlertService.evaluate() works in isolation but is never called from _run_trading.
No notify_kill_switch flag. RuntimeControlService.activate_kill_switch() always writes KILL_SWITCH_ACTIVATED to audit_logs. Mandatory, not configurable.
notify_strategy_promotion_events is persisted to operator_settings but no code reads it. Governance state changes (research -> paper -> live) do not trigger any notification.
notify_pipeline_failures flag exists in operator_settings but no pipeline failure hooks, notifiers, or event handlers have been implemented.
